44: 		switch value := v.(type) {

51: 		case []interface{}:

54: 			}
55: 			values := make([]string, len(value))
56: 			for i, v := range value {
57: 				switch value := v.(type) {

59: 					values[i] = value
60: 				case bool:

62: 				case []string:

64: 				}
65: 			}
66: 			labelValue = strings.Join(values, separator)
67: 		case map[string]interface{}:
68: 			subParameter := Parameters(value)
69: 			prefix := strutil.SanitizeLabelName(k + "_")
70: 			for subk, subv := range subParameter.toLabels() {
71: 				labels[model.LabelName(prefix)+subk] = subv
